feeds.title: Bristol Live
feeds.description: Bristol Live gives all latest update about sport & business from Bristol, crime, education, health, travel, politics, history, celebs and many more.

feeds.title: The Celebrant Directory Blog
feeds.description: The Celebrant Directory is an online directory dedicated to couples and families who seek a unique and personalised ceremony for their special occasions. The Celebrant Directory offers full and professional profiles of each Celebrant, detailing their experience, style, training and offers a full library of images so you can get to know the Celebrant before making contact. Read guides to get inspired & create your ideal ceremony.

feeds.title: Bristol Old Vic Theatre Blog
feeds.description: At Bristol Old Vic, the aim is to create a programme which engages with, and reflects, the vitality, variety and vibrancy of extraordinary city. They hope to contribute to many of the building relationships and working with artists, audiences, spaces and places to create world class theatre and performance that Bristol deserves.

feeds.title: The BRISTOLIAN
feeds.description: The Bristolian is a scandal sheet covering all sorts of shenanigans in the fine city of Bristol, England. The Bristolian will continue to smite the high and mighty every month in print and online because it's the paper that all Bristol really did ask for.

feeds.title: Bristol Tutors Blog
feeds.description: Bristol Tutors has been founded upon the principles of excellence and friendliness; we aim to be an affordable and accessible arranger of quality tuition services in Bristol and the South West. Welcome to the Bristol Tutors blog. Here we share insights, tips and news on all things education.

feeds.title: University of Bristol
feeds.description: The University is internationally renowned, ranked in the top 40 universities globally (QS World University Rankings), due to its outstanding teaching and research, its superb facilities and highly talented students and staff. Blog gives all the news and updates regarding the University.

feeds.title: These Four Walls Blog
feeds.description: These Four Walls is set by Abi to share interiors, lifestyle and travel inspiration from Bristol (UK) and beyond. The spaces she love, the places she visit, the things that catch her eye and the people she meet - always with a focus on Scandinavian design, calming colours and simple, relaxed living.

feeds.title: Albert Palmer Blog
feeds.description: Albert Palmer a reportage wedding photographer in Bristol. He unobtrusively capture beautiful images for people getting married.

feeds.title: Boak & Bailey's
feeds.description: Boak & Bailey's Beer, covers real ale, craft beer, pubs and British beer history. The blog provides all the details by considering the taste, history, pub reports and commentary.

feeds.title: Mr B & Friends
feeds.description: Mr B & Friends is an Independent Creative Agency that crafts beautiful and successful brands. They are Advertising, Digital, Marketing and Brand consultants. They think, they design, they execute, they get the results and we get the picture.

feeds.title: Bristol Aquarium
feeds.description: Bristol's biggest aquarium discovers thousands of aquatic creatures, including tropical fish, sharks, piranhas and seahorses, in more than 40 exciting displays. It has a giant botanical house showcasing hundreds of exotic plant and tree species from around the world.

feeds.title: The Bristol Magazine
feeds.description: The Bristol Magazine Online provides information on all things related to culture, food & drink, lifestyle and education in the wonderful city of Bristol. Main aim is to keep readers informed of all the good things going on in the city, previewing events across a diverse cultural mix, from comedy and children's events to art and drama, and reporting on the city's myriad of festivals.

feeds.title: Bristol Airport Spotting Blog
feeds.description: A website dedicated to providing the best information, news, and events related to spotting aircraft at Bristol Airport. We share necessary information that includes a positive spotting experience at Bristol Airport, and a place to share photos and videos.

feeds.title: A Life Less Organised
feeds.description: I am Shonette, I live in Bristol in the UK. I spend most of my time going to gigs, persuading friends to go to restaurants with me, and drinking my way through the best beers or rum cocktails any licensed establishment has to offer. Keep up to date with the latest food guides by subscribing to the blog.

feeds.title: Ami Rose
feeds.description: Ami Rose blog is about beauty, health, travel, food and lifestyle. Follow this blog to get latest updates and tips and tricks about a healthy lifestyle.

feeds.title: Bristol Mum
feeds.description: Bristol Mum blog provides information about activities to enjoy, places to visit, weekly activities for 0 - 4s, education, support for parents and family-friendly events coming up in Bristol.

feeds.title: Bristol Independent Design Collective Blog
feeds.description: Independent Design Collective is a craft based gift shop, featuring and promoting designers and makers from the local area of Bristol.The shop features a breadth of different designers and artists, and regularly updates its collection, so there is always something new to discover.

feeds.title: Bristol Nordic Walking Blog
feeds.description: Nordic walking Blog provides a total body workout which is outdoors, sociable and fun. Nordic walking turns a walk into a workout so you will lose weight, tone up and enjoy your exercise

feeds.title: Better Food Blog
feeds.description: Better Food mission is to build a better, fairer food community. To do this, they will be the best independent retailer in making organic and local food accessible to all, whilst respecting and celebrating all in the food chain.

feeds.title: Bath & Unwind Blog
feeds.description: Bath & Unwind Beauty Blog is the Destination for Beauty Lovers. This is a place to learn all about beauty, with tips and tricks from the experts. It also provides luxury bath & body, skincare and haircare products.

feeds.title: Bristol Arts Jobs and Opportunities
feeds.description: The job market is tough at the moment in the arts sector, especially with so many cuts. Bristol Arts Jobs and Opportunities blog is dedicated to sourcing jobs, volunteering, internships and a place to find arts jobs and opportunities in and around Bristol to help you gain experience in your chosen field.

feeds.title: The Beer Emporium
feeds.description: The Beer Emporium is an underground Bar/Restaurant/Award Winning Bottle Shop in the heart of Bristol Old Town, the 'Beermuda Triangle'. It offers an extensive range of quality beers on keg, cask and bottle; but also cider, wine and authentic Italian Pizza (also Vegan).

feeds.title: Breaks and Bites
feeds.description: I am Emily. The aim of this site is to keep Bristolians and visitors up to date with what's happening in the foodie world in their area.

feeds.title: Bristol 24/7
feeds.description: Bristol 24/7 keeps updated with latest news, what's on, culture, food and drink, lifestyle, LGBT , business, sport, festivals, culture and more.

feeds.title: The Bristol Parent Blog
feeds.description: The Bristol Parent Blog is about family lifestyle, things to see and do, in Bristol and beyond. Blog is a great resource for locals and visitors to Bristol and the South West of England who are always looking for a new answer to the question 'what shall we do today?'.

feeds.title: Bristol Museum Blog
feeds.description: Bristol Museum Blog explores the collections of art, nature and history of Bristol.

feeds.title: Steel Vintage Blog
feeds.description: Steel Vintage specialised in the design and production of bespoke luxury handmade vintage industrial furniture including tables, desks, storage and seating for commercial and domestic use.

feeds.title: Bristol Cathedral
feeds.description: Standing in the heart of its vibrant city, Bristol Cathedral is one of England's great medieval churches. It boasts some of the UK's most important medieval architecture.

feeds.title: mummy and me x2
feeds.description: Hi lovelies, I'm jade a busy mummy of two from Bristol I love to blog about my hobbies (comping, writing reviews, trying new products), children, money-saving lifestyle and thrift fashion. I love to create content in my spare time and I'm always up for the challenge.

feeds.title: Gough Quarters
feeds.description: Gough Quarters are a leading independent, family run lettings and management agency covering Bristol and the surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Balance
feeds.description: Paul Waters, Balance health and fitness blog is about to achieve what you want, be it fitness, health, weight loss or wellbeing. Blog is also dedicated to helping people lose weight healthily and keep it off using the simple to follow 'think, eat, live, move' programme unique to balance their life.
